caption: Creamy beige tonkotsu broth, glossy with oil sheen and green flecks, swirls around noodles and toppings. A halved boiled egg with runny yolk and crispy chashu pork rests in a white ceramic bowl with blue swirls, on a dark wooden table.

segments_info.text: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle reflections near the bowl's edge.
The chashu pork is a round, browned slice with a slightly crispy surface and visible marbling.
The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy beige, glossy, and rich, swirling around noodles and toppings with visible oil sheen and scattered green flecks.
A halved boiled egg shows a runny orange yolk surrounded by a pale white, with a slightly textured surface.
White ceramic bowl with blue swirling pattern and slightly raised rim, smooth surface with faint residue along inner edge.
